events.name: Lakṣāgṛha
events.summary: The house of lac — an assassination plot against the Pāṇḍavas.
events.description: Traditional accounts place the lac-house episode near Vāraṇāvata. Coordinates are educational approximations, not a surveyed archaeological pin.

events.name: Dice Game
events.summary: The fatal game of dice in the Sabhā at Hastināpura.
events.description: The dyūta that leads to exile is traditionally located in the Kuru capital. Exact hall location is not historically fixed.

events.name: Draupadī Svayaṃvara
events.summary: Arjuna wins Draupadī's hand in Pañcāla.
events.description: Placed at the Pañcāla court by tradition. Pin is approximate.

events.name: Bhagavad Gītā
events.summary: Kṛṣṇa's counsel to Arjuna on the field of Kurukṣetra.
events.description: The discourse is traditionally set on the battlefield of Kurukṣetra before the war. Location follows the Kurukṣetra place pin.

events.name: Bhīṣma Falls
events.summary: Bhīṣma is brought down on the bed of arrows.
events.description: Traditional Kurukṣetra battlefield episode. Pin is approximate within the war landscape.

events.name: Abhimanyu
events.summary: Abhimanyu enters the cakravyūha and falls.
events.description: Kurukṣetra war episode. Educational pin near the battlefield.

events.name: Kīcaka Episode
events.summary: Bhīma slays Kīcaka in the kingdom of Virāṭa.
events.description: Set during the year in disguise at Virāṭa. Placement follows the Matsya / Virāṭa tradition.

events.name: Aśvamedha
events.summary: Yudhiṣṭhira's horse sacrifice after the war.
events.description: Traditionally associated with the restored Kuru court. Exact itinerary of the horse is not fully specified.
